games.title: Abyss Reaper 暗渊割草者
games.description: A survivors-like horde roguelite in the abyss! Steer the bone-white reaper with WASD while your weapons auto-target and shred endless waves of blood-red horrors. Collect XP crystals, pick from three upgrades each level, and evolve a maxed weapon into its true form when its matching passive reaches level 3 — the Blood Moon Great Scythe, Plague Mire and more. Elites arrive every 90 seconds, the Ultimate Death Boss descends at 10 minutes with five bullet waves and deadly charges, and surviving 15 minutes triggers the Reaper's victory. Dodge, reap, evolve, and outlast the abyss.
games.controls: Move with WASD / arrow keys, or drag the on-screen virtual joystick on touch. Weapons fire automatically at nearby enemies. Collect green XP crystals to level up and choose 1 of 3 upgrades (keys 1/2/3 or click). Max a weapon to level 8 and raise its linked passive to 3+ to unlock its evolution. Grab drumsticks to heal and magnets to vacuum every crystal. P pauses, M mutes. Survive 15 minutes and defeat the Death Boss to win.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Age Test Memory Game
games.description: Test your memory and reaction speed! Remember the numbers that appear on screen, then tap them in ascending order. This classic memory challenge tests your brain power and quick thinking. Can you beat the clock and prove you have the memory of a pro?
games.controls: Memorize the numbers for 3 seconds. When the numbers disappear, tap them in ascending order (1, 2, 3, etc.) as quickly as possible. Complete all numbers to advance to the next level.

games.title: Air Strike Battle
games.description: Take to the skies in this exciting air combat game! Pilot your fighter jet, engage enemy aircraft, and destroy targets in intense aerial battles. Test your reflexes and strategic thinking as you navigate through challenging missions.
games.controls: Use mouse or touch to control your fighter jet. Click or tap to fire missiles at enemy aircraft. Avoid enemy fire and destroy all targets to complete each mission.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Aqua Conduit 水脉连环
games.description: A midnight-indigo pipe-rotation puzzle from the Guizang night series. Rotate straight pipes, elbows, tees and cross bridges to lead the hidden spring to a glazed fountain or a waterwheel. Later chapters add brass gate valves that only open at the right angle, one-way valves that refuse reverse flow, straight-only cross channels, and twin-colour springs where jade and azure water must never mix. Twenty-four authored levels across four chapters, each with a real reference solution and a limited move budget; leftover moves convert into score and up to three stars. Every board is procedurally drawn on Canvas with copper pipe walls, flowing jade water, valve wheels, ripples and sparks, and all sound is synthesised WebAudio. No external requests.
games.controls: Click or tap any rotatable pipe to turn it 90 degrees clockwise; right-click or Shift-click turns it counter-clockwise. Arrow keys / WASD move the keyboard cursor and Space or Enter rotates the focused pipe (Shift+Space reverses). R restarts the current level, P pauses, M mutes. The goal is to connect every water source to its matching fountain or waterwheel before the move budget runs out. Gate valves show 通 when open and 闭 when shut; one-way valves only conduct along their gold arrow; cross bridges conduct straight through only, never turning. Clear a level to unlock the next; stars reward few moves and a fast clear.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Baba Game
games.description: A fun casual game where you mark places you've visited. Explore different locations and collect achievements!
games.controls: Use mouse or touch to interact with the game interface. Click on locations to mark them as visited.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Beat the Cat
games.description: Tired of seeing that neurotic cat all over your social feed? Now it's time to beat it! A fun casual game that tests your reaction speed and hand-eye coordination.
games.controls: Click on the cat to beat it before it escapes. The faster your reaction, the higher your score!
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Simple and easy to play gameplay

games.title: Beat the Tiger
games.description: A fast-paced action game where you tap the tiger to score points! Test your reaction speed and hand-eye coordination in this exciting arcade-style game. Hit the tiger as many times as possible before time runs out!
games.controls: Click or tap on the tiger to hit it and score points. The faster you react, the higher your score!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Black Tiles Game
games.description: A fast-paced puzzle game where you must tap only the black tiles and avoid the white ones. Test your reflexes and concentration in multiple game modes including Classic, Zen, Relay, Arcade, and Speed modes.
games.controls: Tap the black tiles as quickly as possible. Avoid tapping the white tiles or the game will end!

games.title: Bouncy Block
games.description: Test your reflexes in this exciting bouncy block game! Tap or click to make the block jump through obstacles and avoid the spikes. How many times can you bounce without dying? Challenge yourself and share your high score with friends!
games.controls: Click or tap to make the block bounce. Time your jumps carefully to avoid spikes and obstacles. The faster you tap, the higher you bounce!

games.title: Bridgewright 造桥匠
games.description: A hand-drawn dusk-canyon bridge builder with a real physical truss under your cursor. Link brass gussets with timber beams, tension-only cables and expensive stone pillars, then send a loaded mine cart across. Every level has a budget, its own span layout, and a cart with a different mass and speed. Deck nodes sag progressively as the cart rolls over them; members glow green, amber and red with stress, and a single overloaded cable can snap the whole structure into the gorge. Eighteen authored levels across three chapters, three-star ratings based on budget, crossing time and peak stress, persistent stars and unlocks, and fully synthesized WebAudio sound and music. No external requests, no image assets — all art is procedural Canvas.
games.controls: Click or tap node A then node B to connect them. Press 1 / 2 / 3 (or tap the cards) to choose timber beam, tension cable or stone pillar. A pillar is placed by clicking a single deck node and automatically drops to the canyon floor. Z undoes the last member with a full refund, R clears and restarts the level, Enter starts the stress test, P pauses, M mutes. Mouse drag from A to B also builds. On touch, tap-tap or drag works. Keep the whole deck connected with beams: the mine cart can only drive across connected beam spans. Earn up to three stars from completion, remaining budget, peak stress and time.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Bubble Pop Game
games.description: Classic bubble shooter puzzle game. Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them and score points. Shoot bubbles strategically to clear the board in this addictive arcade-style game.
games.controls: Click or tap to shoot bubbles. Match 3+ bubbles of the same color to pop them. Clear all bubbles to advance to the next level.

games.title: Bun Eating Contest
games.description: A fun casual game where you see how many steamed buns you can eat in a limited time! Test your speed and reaction skills.
games.controls: Click on the buns to eat them. Try to eat as many as possible within the time limit to get a high score.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Bunny Challenge
games.description: A cute bunny-themed casual game where you experience the adorable bunny world
games.controls: Click the button to play. Try to complete as many challenges as possible within the time limit
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Car Crash Rally
games.description: An exciting crash rally game where you drive and crash to unlock different car types! From bicycles to Lamborghinis, test your luck in this thrilling car collision game.
games.controls: Click or tap to control your car and crash into objects

games.title: Cash Catch Rush
games.description: Cash Catch Rush is a 20-second reflex game: tap the falling banknotes and avoid the bombs. Grab as much cash as you can before time runs out!
games.controls: Tap the banknote tiles as they scroll past. Miss or hit a bomb and the run ends.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: CEO Fortune Quiz
games.description: Spin the wheel and discover which company you'll become CEO of! Enter your name and test your fortune to see if you'll lead tech giants like Baidu, Tencent, Alibaba, or other major corporations. A fun personality quiz game for entertainment.
games.controls: Enter your name in the input field and click the START button to spin the wheel. Watch it rotate and stop at your fortune result. Click 'Test Again' to try for a different outcome.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Color Brain Challenge
games.description: Test your color perception and brain coordination with this challenging color puzzle game
games.controls: Click on the color that matches the text color, not the word meaning

games.title: Crucible Atelier 坩埚炼金坊
games.description: A night-indigo 2D idle alchemy workshop drawn entirely with Canvas. Begin with a drop of water and a handful of ash, then climb a 36-recipe dependency tree of herbs, salts, copper, starlight and glass. Four automation lines (gather, distill, synthesize, package) turn raw matter into materials, gold and essence while you are away, banking up to eight hours of offline output at your current line efficiency. Overload the crucible for triple yields at the cost of furnace pressure — push it to 100 and the workshop explodes. Prestige by re-forging the furnace heart to keep a permanent +15% output per inherited ember. Forge the Starfall Crucible to complete the Great Work.
games.controls: Click or tap the crucible (or the 采撷 button) to gather water, ash and materials. Click a recipe card to select and craft it; the recipe tree unlocks tier by tier. Click a production-line card to upgrade it, or press 1-4 to select / press again to upgrade. Q crafts the selected recipe, W crafts the first craftable recipe, E crafts every available recipe once. The overload button (超载催炼) triples a craft's output but adds +28 furnace pressure; at 100 the furnace explodes. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts the current run. A single tap on the recipe card, line card, gather button and quick-craft buttons is supported on touch devices; the layout adapts to landscape and portrait.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Cube Tetris Game
games.description: Mind-bending block puzzle game that will test your skills. Navigate through challenging cube formations in this unique twist on classic tetris-style gameplay.
games.controls: Use Left/Right buttons to move blocks. Tap Rotate to change block orientation. Clear lines by filling complete rows.

games.title: Danger Ranger
games.description: An exciting action-adventure game where you play as a ranger navigating through dangerous terrains. Face challenges, avoid obstacles, and complete missions in this thrilling mobile-friendly game!
games.controls: Arrow keys or on-screen controls to move, avoid obstacles and complete missions
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Danmaku Shrine 弹幕魔境
games.description: A vertical bullet-hell boss rush through a haunted shrine! Four yokai bosses each guard two phases of dense rotating spell cards. Your hitbox is a tiny 2.5px dot — hold Shift for precision focus mode and weave through curtains of glowing danmaku. Graze bullets for bonus points and fill the extend meter for extra bombs, bomb-clear overwhelming patterns, and either outlast the spell timer to capture it or blast the boss down for kill bonuses. Survive all four bosses to suppress the realm!
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move, hold Shift for slow focus mode (shows your hitbox), X to bomb (clears all bullets, 3 charges + extends from graze meter). Player shots are automatic. P pauses, M mutes. Touch: drag pad to move, focus and bomb buttons on the right.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Deep Catch Saga 深海垂钓记
games.description: A relaxing three-stage fishing saga with a 42-fish collection book! Charge and release your cast to aim for the deep, steer your hook past rocks and jellyfish as it sinks through six depth layers, then win the tension tug-of-war: hold to reel when the fish is calm, let go while it struggles, or the line snaps after three bursts. Deeper water hides rarer catches — from common sprats in the shallows all the way to legendary crowned monsters of the abyss, each drawn procedurally with its own colors, patterns and glow. Fill the picture dex for milestone coin rewards, spend coins on boat upgrades (sink speed, tension tolerance, rarity luck, magnet assist), and chase your best single-catch record. Cozy synth soundtrack, day-night sky, touch-friendly controls, no fail state — just you and the sea.
games.controls: Stage 1 — press Space or tap to stop the swinging needle; stopping near the center casts farther and unlocks deeper water. Stage 2 — steer the hook with A/D (or hold the left/right half of the screen); hold Space, S or the reel button to pull the line back up early; touching rocks reels you in, jellyfish stun you for 0.8s. Stage 3 — hold Space or the screen to reel while the fish is calm, release while it struggles; three tension bursts snap the line. B opens the fish dex, U opens boat upgrades, P pauses, M mutes.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Dodge Police 18s
games.description: Escape from the police in this intense survival game! Dodge the police officers for 18 seconds to prove your skills. The longer you survive, the higher your score. How long can you evade the cops?
games.controls: Touch or click and drag your avatar to dodge the police officers. Avoid contact at all costs! Move quickly and strategically to survive for 18 seconds. The police move faster as time progresses.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Dodge the Lover
games.description: A fast-paced action game where you dodge the lover while collecting points! Test your reflexes and timing skills as you navigate through increasingly challenging obstacles. Click on the right blocks to escape and survive as long as possible!
games.controls: Tap or click on blocks to dodge. Match the correct blocks to escape the lover and score points. Avoid wrong blocks that will end your game. The faster you react, the higher your score!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Don't Die Challenge
games.description: A thrilling survival game where you must avoid obstacles and stay alive as long as possible. Test your reflexes and endurance!
games.controls: Use arrow keys or WASD to move and avoid obstacles. Stay alive as long as possible!

games.title: Dot Eater
games.description: A classic Pac-Man style arcade game where you navigate through mazes, collect dots, and avoid enemies. Test your reflexes and strategy skills!
games.controls: Use arrow keys or WASD keys to move your character. Collect all dots while avoiding enemies to advance to the next level.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Dots Mania
games.description: Connect same-colored dots in Dots Mania. The longer your chain, the higher the multiplier - plan every one of your 20 moves carefully to post a top score.
games.controls: Drag across adjacent dots of the same color to connect them. Longer chains score more points; you have 20 moves per round.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Dragon Rescue Mission
games.description: Help the dragon rescue his son in this exciting action-adventure game. Navigate through challenges and obstacles to complete your mission!
games.controls: Use touch controls to move and interact. Collect items and avoid obstacles to progress through levels.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Dream Merge 2048
games.description: Swipe to merge matching tiles and climb the ladder of life goals, from Single Life to Dream Come True in this 2048-style puzzle.
games.controls: Swipe or use arrow keys to move all tiles. Equal tiles merge when they touch. Reach the Dream Come True tile to win.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Echo Hour 回声之时
games.description: A hand-authored time-loop puzzle platformer in deep indigo and warm copper. Record up to eight seconds of your own movement, stop, and a ghostly echo loops that action forever — it can hold pressure plates and trip timed switches for you, but it cannot pick up the hourglasses and star grains. Hold Q or Shift to rewind yourself and nearby time mechanisms up to three seconds, restoring moving platforms, laser cadence, conveyors and crushers to a past state that lets you pass. Twelve authored levels across three chapters combine both abilities with seven mechanism classes. Optional hourglasses and star grains are extra objectives; stars are rated on clear time and rewind count. Procedural Canvas art, synthesized WebAudio, no external assets.
games.controls: A / D or Left / Right to walk, Space / W / Up to jump. E starts and stops an 8-second echo recording; the echo then loops and can press plates and switches. Hold Q or Shift to rewind yourself and local mechanisms up to 3 seconds. R restarts the level, P pauses, M mutes. On touch, use the on-screen left/right, jump, record (录) and rewind (溯) buttons. Reach the copper hour gate to clear the level. Optional hourglasses and star grains add score; star rating depends on clear time and how many rewinds you used.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Egyptian IQ Test
games.description: Challenge your intelligence with this ancient Egyptian pattern completion IQ test. Measure your cognitive abilities through spatial reasoning and pattern recognition.
games.controls: Click on the options (A-H) to complete the pattern. Fill in all 6 answers and submit to see your IQ score.

games.title: Emberpin 余烬弹珠台
games.description: A hand-authored molten-gold pinball table in charcoal and glazed vermilion. Charge the spring plunger, launch the chrome ball up the right lane and work two genuinely rotating flippers through pop bumpers, glowing scoring rings, kicker slingshots and three groups of drop targets. Light all three targets in a group to raise the score multiplier and earn multiball or an extra ball; light all three groups and reach 60,000 points to finish the run. Three balls, a 2.4-second combo chain, ember particle bursts, glass-dome reflections and synthesized WebAudio arcade music. Everything is procedural Canvas art with no external assets.
games.controls: Hold Space to charge the plunger and release to launch. A / Left Arrow works the left flipper, D / Right Arrow the right flipper. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts. On touch, tap or hold the left and right halves of the table (or the two on-screen flipper buttons) to flip, and press the 发射 button to charge and launch. Light all three targets in a task group for a multiplier step; complete all three groups and reach the 60,000 target score to win.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Face Pair Match
games.description: Flip cards and match pairs of hilarious faces against the clock in Face Pair Match. Remember every position, clear all the pairs before time runs out, and beat your best score in this fast-paced memory game.
games.controls: Click or tap a card to flip it over. Match two identical faces to keep them open. Find every pair before the 60-second timer runs out.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Fiery Dragon
games.description: Control a fiery dragon in this exciting arcade adventure! Navigate through challenging levels, avoid obstacles, and test your reflexes in this classic dragon game. Experience the thrill of flying a powerful dragon through dangerous territories.
games.controls: Use arrow keys or on-screen controls to move the dragon. Avoid obstacles and enemies to survive as long as possible.

games.title: Find the Different Face
games.description: Scan a grid of nearly identical faces and tap the one odd face out in Find the Different Face. The grid keeps growing as you speed up - how many will you spot in 60 seconds?
games.controls: Click or tap the single different face in each grid. Find them quickly to build your streak before the timer runs out.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Fly Higher Challenge
games.description: An exciting flying game where you navigate upward through obstacles and challenges. Test your reflexes and timing skills as you soar higher and higher. How far can you fly?
games.controls: Tap or click to fly upward. Avoid obstacles and collect items to score points. Time your movements carefully to reach maximum height!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Fortune Money Game
games.description: Help the god of prosperity collect money in this fun and engaging game! Tap the left and right arrows alternatively to collect your money before time runs out. Inspired by the Chinese god of prosperity, Cai Shen.
games.controls: Click or tap the LEFT and RIGHT arrows alternatively to collect money. Time is limited, so be quick!

games.title: Fortune Quiz Game
games.description: Discover the key to your wealth and fortune! Take this engaging personality quiz to find out what will bring you financial success. Answer 10 carefully crafted questions about your lifestyle, preferences, and habits to reveal your unique path to prosperity.
games.controls: Click or tap on the options to answer each question. Use the back button to review previous questions. Complete all 10 questions to discover your fortune key!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Frostpuck Arena 霜锋冰球
games.description: A frost-lit 2D air-hockey duel on a midnight aurora rink. Drag your glowing mallet, read the bounce, and slam the puck past the opposing goal. Play solo against Frostshade AI on three genuinely different difficulty tiers, or share the keyboard with a friend in local two-player mode (WASD vs arrow keys). First to 7 wins. Elastic mallet physics, wall rebounds, real opening countdowns, goal fireworks, screen shake, a fastest-win record and a fully synthesized ice-court soundtrack. Pure Canvas art, no external assets.
games.controls: Single player: move the lower mallet with mouse or touch drag (WASD also works). Local two-player: P1 uses WASD, P2 uses arrow keys. Push the puck past the top goal to score; defend the bottom goal. First to 7 points wins. P pauses, M mutes. Choose Easy / Medium / Hard AI or local two-player from the title menu. Touch controls are supported.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Glyphbeast: Sixfold Trail 符兽六道
games.description: A night-indigo, ink-and-copper turn-based monster-tamer road. Explore four wild zones on the Champion Trail, meet and weaken twelve hand-drawn-in-code rune-beasts, then throw paper seals to capture them into a four-member party. Every beast knows three skills (damage, status, heal or shield), speed decides turn order, and six elements form a full counter cycle: Flame beats Gale, Gale beats Stone, Stone beats Tide, Tide beats Light, Light beats Shadow and Shadow beats Flame (1.5x advantage, 0.67x resisted). Campfires heal the whole party for free, the roadside shop sells more seals, and four gatekeepers guard the road in increasing difficulty. Win battles for coins and experience, switch beasts mid-battle, manage status effects, and defeat all four bosses to light the final lamp. All art, animation, sound and music are procedural; no external assets or requests.
games.controls: Explore with Arrow keys or WASD; press E or Enter to interact with the campfire, shop and boss gates; C opens the 12-beast codex; P pauses; M mutes. In battle, press 1-4 (or click/tap the command cards) for Skills, Throw Seal, Switch Beast and Flee. Skills open a 1-3 submenu; Arrow keys move the selection and Enter confirms. In the party submenu, 1-4 or click/tap chooses a beast. All buttons are pointer/touch friendly, and on touch devices a D-pad and interact button appear; tapping the battlefield also walks toward that point. Esc backs out of submenus and closes overlays. All UI text is in Chinese.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Gold Miner
games.description: Classic gold mining game where you use a hook to grab gold and gems underground.
games.controls: Click or tap to launch the hook and grab valuable items

games.title: Hit Me!
games.description: A fun and exciting Cocos2d-HTML5 action game! Tap to attack and dodge in this thrilling game. Challenge yourself with fast-paced gameplay and see how long you can survive!
games.controls: Tap the screen to play. Use touch controls to interact with the game. Simple and intuitive gameplay for everyone!

games.title: Hive IO 蜂巢大作战
games.description: A 3D snake-io battle in a glowing flower meadow! Guide your queen bee to devour nectar orbs and grow longer, boost-sprint to cut off rivals, and trap smaller bees with your body — head-on duels kill the smaller bee and scatter its body into juicy nectar. 12 AI bees with three personalities (gluttons, hunters, wanderers) hunt and flee in real time. Rich flower patches hold extra nectar but hide venomous thorns. Cross the 100-length threshold to be crowned — or crash into the thorn hedge trying!
games.controls: Move the mouse (or drag on touch) to steer your bee; hold left click / Space to boost (consumes length and drops nectar behind you). Head-on: the smaller bee dies. Never hit another bee's body with your head. P pauses, M mutes.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: How Many Hits?
games.description: Time your swing perfectly to smack the swinging chain ball with the iron hammer. How many clean hits can you land before you miss?
games.controls: Tap when the ball swings into range to swing the hammer. Perfect timing scores a hit.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Hyper Gunner
games.description: Defend Earth in Hyper Gunner, a classic vertical space shooter. Blast waves of alien fighters, survive level after level, and log your miles from home.
games.controls: Move with the arrow keys or A/D, or drag on the touch screen. Fire at the incoming aliens and destroy them all to clear each level.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Ice Bucket Challenge
games.description: Take the ice bucket challenge! Drop ice buckets on characters and enjoy the refreshing splash in this fun casual game.
games.controls: Click or tap to drop the ice bucket at the right moment

games.title: Ironwright Arena 锻甲机斗场
games.description: An iron-and-ember 2D Canvas mech foundry and three-boss arena. In the forge, assemble a rig from 6 weapons, 6 armor plates and 4 thrusters; every part measurably changes firepower, cadence, heat, armor, weight, movement speed, dash and hover. Then face three furnace wardens one after another, reading their telegraphed slams, radial volleys, sweeping lances, cross-beams, missile rain and the colossus's half-health overdrive. Earn coins and parts, spend a single limited repair between bouts, and chase a best clear time. Procedural mech silhouettes, forge sparks, hit-stop, screen shake and fully synthesized WebAudio with no external assets.
games.controls: WASD / Arrow keys move, move the mouse to aim, hold left click or J to fire, Shift or K to dash, E to raise the melt-core barrier, P to pause, M to mute, R to restart the run. On touch: the left stick moves, the right stick aims and fires, and the 冲刺 / E 屏障 buttons trigger dash and barrier. Beat all three bosses to complete the run; repairs and part swaps happen at the foundry between fights.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Island Quiz Game
games.description: Test your knowledge of Japanese islands and culture in this engaging quiz game. Choose between picture mode to identify locations from images or name mode to match names with locations.
games.controls: Tap on your answer choice. You have limited time and lives to complete each level. Clear levels by answering correctly.

games.title: Laser Defense
games.description: Draw laser lines to defend your base in this fast-paced action game. Test your reflexes as you sketch defenses against incoming threats. How long can you survive?
games.controls: Use your finger or mouse to draw laser lines. Touch and drag to create defenses that block incoming enemies.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Lexicon Bastion 词垒防线
games.description: A night-paper typing defence. English words ride down with glazed vermilion enemies toward a stone word-fortress; type each word letter by letter, lock the target, and complete it to fire a copper barrage. Wrong keys break the combo and cost accuracy, while combo and accuracy charge an automatic word-fortress volley. Four enemy archetypes (slow high-HP slabs, fast darters, splitters that spawn shards, and shield-bearers that absorb a whole word) escalate across endless waves, with long multi-segment boss words on wave 8, wave 10 and every eighth wave thereafter. Beating the wave 10 boss raises a milestone complete and opens endless mode. Ink energy buys one of three upgrades between waves (barrage damage, shorter word cap, or fortress HP). Accuracy, WPM, best combo and highest wave persist locally. Fully procedural Canvas art and synthesized WebAudio; no external requests or assets.
games.controls: Type the English word directly on the keyboard. The first letter locks the closest matching word; keep typing to finish it and fire. A wrong letter breaks the combo and lowers accuracy. Click or tap an enemy to lock it manually. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts; these shortcut letters still type normally when they are the next expected letter. On touch, tap the in-page input field to open the system keyboard, or reveal the 26-key in-page keyboard; pause / mute / restart buttons sit beside it. Between waves choose one of three ink-priced upgrades or rest to heal. At the wave 10 milestone you can continue into endless, view the settlement, or restart.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Light Bulb Puzzle
games.description: A challenging logic puzzle game where you need to light up all the bulbs! Click on bulbs to toggle them on and off, but beware - clicking one bulb affects its neighbors. Find the strategy to illuminate every bulb in the fewest moves possible!
games.controls: Click on bulbs to toggle them on or off. When you click a bulb, it and its adjacent bulbs will change state. Light up all bulbs to win!
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Step counter to track your efficiency

games.title: Lumberjack Tap
games.description: Chop the giant tree nonstop in Lumberjack Tap. Switch sides at the perfect moment to dodge incoming branches and keep chopping as fast as you can to set a new record.
games.controls: Tap the left or right side of the screen to switch chopping sides. Dodge the branches and chop as much timber as you can.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Mind Reader Game
games.description: Amazing mind-reading magic trick that will amaze your friends! Think of a card and watch as the game reads your mind. Can you figure out the secret?
games.controls: Tap the cards to play. Follow the instructions on screen. This is a magical mind-reading experience!

games.title: Monster Shooter Rush
games.description: Fly into battle in Monster Shooter Rush, a vertical arcade shooter. Blast waves of monsters, dodge their counterattacks, and grab coins and power-ups to push your score ever higher.
games.controls: Touch and drag or move the mouse to steer your hero - firing is automatic. Dodge enemy fire, collect bombs and power-ups, and survive as long as you can.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Moon Landing Challenge
games.description: Navigate your spacecraft through space and land safely on the moon! Control thrust and direction to achieve perfect landings while managing your fuel supply.
games.controls: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to control your spacecraft. UP/W for thrust, LEFT/A and RIGHT/D to steer. Land gently on the green landing pads to score points!
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Multiple landing zones with different point values

games.title: Moon Rabbit Jump
games.description: Moon Rabbit Jump is a rope-launch distance game with a Mid-Autumn twist. Swipe to cut the rope, time your swings and bounce past branches and sky soldiers toward the moon!
games.controls: Swipe the rope at the hand hint to launch. The shorter the rope, the higher the bunny flies. Tap again at the right moment to keep flying.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Mummy Maze Escape
games.description: Guide the explorer through 50 hand-made maze rooms. Plan every move to avoid the patrolling mummy and reach the locked exit door in this classic top-down puzzle.
games.controls: Tap the on-screen arrows to move one tile at a time. Reach the door without the mummy catching you.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Name Duel
games.description: Enter two names and watch them duel with random attacks, charms, crits and lucky comebacks. Every battle tells a ridiculous story - whose name wins?
games.controls: Type two names and press the big button to auto-battle. Tap Play Again for a new matchup.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Nebula Run 星窟狂奔
games.description: A neon 3-lane 3D endless runner through a star cavern! Sprint down a crumbling nebula track, switch lanes, leap with held-charge jumps and slide under energy beams. Slip past obstacles by a hair to trigger slow-motion near-miss bonuses, blast through blue ×2 / gold ×3 / purple ×5 multiplier gates, and ride glowing tunnel sections every 500m with music shifts. A shield absorbs one crash and resupplies every 1200m. How far can you run before the void takes you?
games.controls: A/D or ←/→ to switch lanes, W/↑/Space to jump (hold for a higher jump), S/↓ to slide under beams. Pass through the tri-color gates for score multipliers, graze past obstacles for near-miss bonuses. P pauses, M mutes. Touch zones provided on mobile.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Nerve Cat Launch
games.description: Fling the crazy cat as far as you can in Nerve Cat Launch. Time your launch perfectly, keep the cat airborne, and chase a new distance record measured in meters.
games.controls: Tap or click to launch the cat, then keep tapping at the right moments to keep it flying. Travel as far as possible.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: OCD Challenge 2
games.description: A challenging puzzle game that tests your attention to detail and perfectionist tendencies. Clear all the notifications and organize everything perfectly!
games.controls: Tap to clear notifications and organize items. Pay attention to details and complete each level perfectly.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Orbit Kart Grand Prix 星环卡丁大奖赛
games.description: A three-dimensional kart racer across three hand-tuned star-ring circuits. Drift through the bend to charge a two-stage boost, grab question boxes for a dash, a homing bolt or a roadblock, and hold off three rubber-band AI rivals over three laps. Grand Prix mode packs a full four-kart race; Time Trial strips it back to a solo hunt for the perfect lap. Best finish and fastest lap are saved per circuit in localStorage.
games.controls: WASD or arrow keys to drive, Shift + steering to drift and charge a boost (release to launch), E or Space to use an item, R to rejoin the track, P or Esc to pause, M to mute. Touch devices get left/right, brake, drift and item buttons. Pick Grand Prix or Time Trial and a circuit on the title screen; cross the line three times to finish.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Orchard Fusion 果园大合成
games.description: A juicy Suika-style merge puzzle! Drop fruits into the orchard jar — identical fruits fuse into the next tier when they touch, chaining combos for multiplied scores. Grow your fruit from cherry all the way to a celebratory watermelon that clears small fruits for bonus points. One more drop could be one line too many: fruits resting above the danger line for 2 seconds end the run. Simple to learn, endlessly replayable, with satisfying physics, pop effects and a soothing synth soundtrack.
games.controls: Move with mouse (or touch-drag), release / tap to drop the fruit. Identical fruits merge on contact — chain merges in one drop for combo multipliers up to ×5. Press X or tap the Next box to swap current and next fruit (once per drop). P pauses, M mutes. Fruits resting above the red danger line for 2 seconds end the run.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Pac-Man Style Game
games.description: Classic Pac-Man style arcade game with dots, ghosts, and power pellets
games.controls: Arrow keys to move
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Power pellets for temporary ghost vulnerability

games.title: Peach Catch Frenzy
games.description: Peach Catch Frenzy is a 59-second catching game: move the monkey basket to catch falling peaches, avoid the bombs and chase the red-envelope bonus.
games.controls: Drag the basket with your finger or mouse (arrow keys also work) to catch peaches and dodge bombs.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Pearl Pop Cascade 珠光瀑语
games.description: A dreamy 3D pachinko-peg puzzle! Aim and fire steel orbs to shatter glowing dream-pearls across a starlit board. Chain hits in one shot to climb the score-multiplier ladder, purple pearls quintuple your shot, green pearls gift free balls. When only 10 pearls remain, FEVER grants three consecutive free orbs. Catch the roaming golden buckets for +1000 and another ball, clear the board for a 5000 bonus and a harder round. A soothing synth lullaby plays as pearls cascade.
games.controls: Move mouse (or touch-drag) to aim from the top launcher, click / tap / press Space to fire. Blue pearls score with a rising per-shot multiplier ladder, purple ×5, green +1 ball. Catch pearls in the moving golden buckets. P pauses, M mutes.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Peek and Pop
games.description: Peek and Pop is a 30-second whack-a-mole reaction game. Pop the peeking faces as they appear, rack up combos and avoid the decoys to beat your friends!
games.controls: Tap the peeking faces in the nine holes. Do not tap the decoy characters.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Picture Puzzle Challenge
games.description: A visual puzzle game featuring beautiful images. Solve puzzles by arranging pieces correctly and test your problem-solving skills!
games.controls: Click and drag to move puzzle pieces. Arrange all pieces correctly to complete each level.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Pink Blue Love Match
games.description: A fun and engaging love matching puzzle game! Match pink and blue characters to test your romance fortune. Challenge yourself with colorful gameplay and see how high you can score in this adorable matching adventure.
games.controls: Tap or click to match pink and blue characters. Complete matches to score points and progress through levels. The better your matching skills, the higher your romance fortune index!
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Cute pink and blue character design

games.title: Pop Star Tap
games.description: Pop Star Tap is a 30-second whack-a-mole reaction game. Tap the stars as they peek out of the nine holes, dodge the joke decoys and earn fun ranks!
games.controls: Tap the popping stars in the holes. Avoid the decoy characters or the run ends.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Prism Paths 光路迷阵
games.description: A laser refraction puzzle on an obsidian board! Rotate mirrors, split beams with prisms, thread through color filters, and bounce off one-shot ice mirrors to light every matching crystal. Purple crystals demand two different colors arriving at once. 30 hand-crafted levels across three chapters — Reflection Basics, Splitting & Filters, and Master Challenges — with par-based star ratings and chapter unlock gates. Pure logic, zero luck: every beam is deterministic.
games.controls: Click / tap any mirror or prism to rotate it 90°. Guide every emitter's beam into its matching color crystal (purple crystals need two distinct colors). Z undoes, R resets the level, P pauses, M mutes.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Prison Memory Match
games.description: Put your memory to the test in Prison Memory Match. Flip the cards, remember every face, and pair them all up before the 60-second timer runs out.
games.controls: Click or tap two cards to flip them over. Match identical faces to lock in the pair and clear the whole board before time runs out.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Prison Whack
games.description: The cells have opened in Prison Whack! Convicts are popping up everywhere - tap them back into their cells, spare the innocent ones, and rack up a huge combo in 35 seconds.
games.controls: Tap or click the escaping convicts to send them back to their cells. Avoid tapping innocent characters or you will lose points.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Relationship Loyalty Test
games.description: A fun personality quiz that tests your loyalty in relationships. Answer questions honestly to discover your relationship tendencies and commitment level.
games.controls: Click on answer choices to progress through the quiz. Share your results with friends to compare scores.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Retro Game Tune Quiz
games.description: Listen to ten classic retro game tunes and name the game! Score points by recognizing Mario, Contra, Castlevania and more in this nostalgic music quiz.
games.controls: Tap Play the tune, then pick the right answer from four options. 10 points per correct tune.
games.author: LightGame
games.notes: Gameplay references classic game IP names and the bundled MP3s are unlicensed third-party music assets.

games.title: Rhythm Starlane 节奏星轨
games.description: A 4-key falling-note rhythm game with three fully synthesized original tracks. Every song is generated live with WebAudio (lead melody, chord pads, drums and bass) and its chart is built from the song's own beat-pattern sequence — note times map exactly from beats to seconds, so what you hit is what you hear. Three difficulties (Easy/Normal/Hard) change density, double-note rate and scroll speed. Judge windows of ±40ms PERFECT and ±90ms GOOD feed combo multipliers (+5% every 25 combo), a Fever mode at 50 combo that doubles scores for 8 seconds with a full-screen light show, and an S/A/B/C/D accuracy grade on the results screen. Per-song per-difficulty best score and accuracy are saved locally.
games.controls: Press D F J K (or tap the four touch zones) to hit falling notes on the four lanes. ±40ms is PERFECT, ±90ms is GOOD, anything else is a MISS that breaks your combo. Every 25 combo adds +5% score bonus; reaching 50 combo triggers Fever (score ×2 for 8 seconds). P pauses (music stops too), M mutes, Esc or the ✕ button ends the song early for an aborted result.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Room Escape Reaction
games.description: Room Escape Reaction is a brutal reflex gauntlet. Spot the signal change in each room and tap instantly - clear every level and prove you could dodge bullets.
games.controls: Watch carefully and tap the screen the moment the signal changes. One slow reaction ends the run.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Save the Sperm
games.description: Guard the zone and rescue as many falling tadpoles as you can in Save the Sperm. Chain catches into combos, level up wave after wave, and set a brand-new rescue record.
games.controls: Drag in the play area to move the catcher. Catch the falling tadpoles, avoid the enemies, and build combos for bonus points.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Sea Treasure Match
games.description: Dive into Sea Treasure Match, a classic match-3 puzzle. Swap sparkling gems to line up three or more, beat the clock, and clear level after level on the ocean floor.
games.controls: Swap two adjacent gems to line up three or more of the same color. Reach the target score before time runs out to advance to the next level.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Secret Admirer Quiz
games.description: Take this fun personality quiz to discover how many secret admirers you have! Spin the wheel and get a playful prediction about your love life. A lighthearted entertainment game that reveals amusing results about your attractiveness and charm.
games.controls: Enter your name and click the START button to spin the wheel. The wheel will rotate and stop at a random result, telling you how many people might have a crush on you. Share your result with friends or try again for a different outcome!

games.title: Shadowspire Ninja 影峰登天
games.description: A vertical paper-cut ninja climb through a 1200-metre tower. Chain wall jumps to enter a flow state, spend chi on i-frame dashes, collect lantern dust to refill chi, and survive warning-pulsing spike traps across the Timber Hold, Wind Gallery and Star Pavilion. Three lives, lantern checkpoints every 150 m, and a persistent best-height record.
games.controls: A/D or Left/Right to move, Space to jump (coyote time, wall slide, wall jump), Shift to dash (costs chi, grants invincibility frames), P to pause, M to mute, R to restart. Touch controls appear on mobile: left/right pads, jump and dash buttons. Chain three wall jumps without landing to trigger a temporary flow speed and score boost.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Silkline Swing 丝线荡跃
games.description: A moonlit canyon swinging platformer with real pendulum physics. Hold to bind a jade silk line to a copper anchor, pump your swing with A/D, reel in or out with W/S and let go to fly on pure inertia. Three star shards float on every route; cross the glazed-vermilion star gate to clear each level. Eighteen hand-authored routes across three chapters introduce moving anchors, fraying silk that snaps under prolonged load, crosswind corridors and spike-toothed rock pillars. Collect all three shards under par time for a three-star clear, unlock the next canyon, and chase a 54-star record. Everything is rendered procedurally on Canvas and synthesized with WebAudio — no images, fonts, CDNs or network requests.
games.controls: Hold Space, the left mouse button or touch on the canvas to grab the best anchor in range (forward anchors are preferred). While bound, press A/D or Left/Right to pump the swing, W/S or Up/Down to shorten/lengthen the silk, and release the grab input to fly off with your current velocity. R restarts the level, P pauses, M mutes. On touch, use the 抓丝 button to hold the silk plus the ←/→ and 收/放 buttons. Collect three star shards and pass through the floating star gate. Spikes and the abyss cost a life and return you to the last checkpoint; three lost lives fail the level. Stars are awarded for clearing, collecting two or three shards, and finishing all three under par time.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Sky City Flight
games.description: Soar through the sky and fly over the majestic Sky City! Navigate your aircraft through challenging obstacles, collect power-ups, and see how high you can fly in this thrilling aerial adventure. Test your reflexes and aim for the highest score as you explore the beautiful sky city landscapes.
games.controls: Touch or click to control your aircraft. Avoid obstacles and collect items to increase your score. The higher you fly, the more challenging it becomes!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Skyscraper Stack
games.description: Time the swinging crane perfectly to stack floors into the sky. Land blocks spot-on for bonus points and beat the world-famous landmarks!
games.controls: Tap when the block is aligned to drop it. Perfect drops keep the tower going.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Sling Siege 弹弓拆塔记
games.description: A dusk-lit slingshot destruction puzzle! Stretch the band, read the dotted trajectory, and unleash stones, bombs and triple-split shots at wobbly wooden towers, stubborn stone forts and shattering glass halls to flatten every green guard. Wood cracks, stone shrugs, glass explodes — bombs detonate with a shockwave that chain-triggers nearby explosives. Crush enemies under collapsing blocks, blast them off ledges, or drop them from fatal heights. Fewer shots, more stars: 24 hand-built levels across three chapters.
games.controls: Drag back from the slingshot to aim (dotted line previews the arc), release to fire. R retries instantly, P pauses, M mutes. Use fewer shots than par for 3 stars and unlock later chapters.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Smartphone Shooter
games.description: Phones are flying everywhere in Smartphone Shooter. Take aim and shoot down as many as you can - every hit counts, so make each shot an accurate one.
games.controls: Tap or click the flying phones to shoot them down. Hit as many as you can before time runs out.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Snake Arena
games.description: An exciting multiplayer snake game where you compete against other players in real-time. Grow your snake by eating food and avoid colliding with other snakes or walls.
games.controls: Arrow Keys / WASD
games.author: 1games.io

games.title: Snake Game
games.description: The classic Snake game where you control a snake to eat food and grow longer. Be careful not to hit the walls or yourself!
games.controls: Use Arrow Keys to move the snake. Eat the food to grow longer. Avoid hitting walls and your own tail.

games.title: Soccer Dash
games.description: Dribble at full speed in Soccer Dash, a World Cup runner. Weave past cones, grab jerseys and power-ups, then take your best shot against the goalkeeper.
games.controls: Drag with your finger or mouse to steer the dribbling player. Collect power-ups, avoid obstacles, and shoot the ball to score.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Space Shooter
games.description: Defend Earth from waves of alien invaders in this classic arcade-style space shooter. Dodge enemy fire and collect power-ups to upgrade your weapons.
games.controls: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to move your spaceship. Press Space to shoot. Avoid enemy ships and their projectiles.

games.title: Stack Wood Game
games.description: Stack the wooden blocks as high as you can! Time your drops perfectly to align the wood pieces and achieve the highest tower. Test your precision and reflexes in this addictive puzzle game where every piece counts.
games.controls: Click or tap to release the wood when it is aligned above the stack. The closer the alignment, the more points you earn. Build your tower as high as possible without any pieces falling off.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Starfall Bulwark
games.description: A dusk-canyon 3D tower defense built with three.js. A fallen star core wakes beside a void portal — build ballistic towers along the winding star-road, chain lightning through crystal beasts, slow them with frost, splash the armored brutes and catch the fliers with prism beams, and turn the tide yourself with three castable powers: Starfall, Frost Nova and Overload Pulse. Roguelite blessing drafts every third wave, random wave events, a colossus boss that stomps your towers offline — and a Deep Tide endless mode where enemies compound +10% per wave, learn to split, shield and burrow, grow armor with depth and march in ever larger colossus packs. Chase your best-wave record.
games.controls: Click a glowing hex pad to open the build menu, then pick one of 5 towers (keys 1-5). Click a built tower to upgrade (U) or sell (X, 70% refund). Cast powers with Q (Starfall), E (Frost Nova), R (Overload Pulse). Space calls the next wave early for +15 essence (or toggles speed during combat), F toggles 1×/2× speed, P pauses, Esc deselects. Clear wave 10 to unlock endless mode. Touch controls supported on mobile.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Steps of Wonder
games.description: A challenging puzzle game that tests your intelligence and strategy. Push your thinking to the limit. Every step matters in this thrilling brain teaser!
games.controls: Click on the blocks to move them. Try to solve the puzzle with as few steps as possible. Careful thinking and planning is required for each move.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Stock Trader Pro
games.description: Test your trading skills in this exciting stock market simulation game! Buy and sell stocks at the right time to maximize your profits. Market trends change rapidly, so stay alert and make smart investment decisions!
games.controls: Use mouse or touch to click Buy/Sell buttons. Watch the market trends and buy stocks when prices are low, sell when high. Monitor your portfolio and react quickly to market changes.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Super Chromosome
games.description: A step-based puzzle where you arrange and color cells to complete levels in the fewest moves.
games.controls: touch

games.title: Super Shooter
games.description: Shoot the football as far as you can! Test your strength and precision in this exciting sports game. Hit the target with maximum power to achieve the greatest distance.
games.controls: Tap the screen repeatedly within 5 seconds to charge up your shot. The faster you tap, the more power you'll generate. Release at the right moment to shoot!
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Sword Shrine Guardian
games.description: A moody isometric 3D action game built with three.js. Take up a spirit blade at a mist-shrouded shrine: read enemy telegraphs, parry to open execution windows, dodge unblockable slams, unleash flying sword qi and a blade rain storm, and break the stone guardians' posture across two-phase boss fights. Elite affixes, random night events, falling meteors, fog merchants and a coin shop rewrite the rules wave by wave — forge your build, hold the shrine through rotating grounds in endless mode, and chase your best-wave record.
games.controls: WASD to move. J or left-click to attack (3-hit combo, third hit is heavy). K or right-click to parry — a successful parry opens an execution window; press attack to execute. Space to dodge (chainable with 迅影). L: sword qi (aim-assisted). U: blade rain AoE — chain after a qi hit for 剑气合击. E: blink strike. After each wave pick 1 of 3 upgrades and spend coins in the shop. Watch for random night events — deep waves stack two. Clear the boss to unlock endless mode. Touch controls supported on mobile.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Tap Frenzy
games.description: Tap Frenzy is a 10-second speed tapping challenge. Mash the heart button as fast as you can, beat your best score and earn speed ranks from Turtle to Lightning!
games.controls: Tap the big heart button repeatedly for 10 seconds. More taps means a higher rank.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Tetris
games.description: The classic block-stacking puzzle game. Arrange falling blocks to create complete lines and prevent the blocks from stacking up to the top.
games.controls: Use Arrow Left/Right to move, Arrow Down to speed up descent, Arrow Up to rotate, Space to hard drop.

games.title: Tickle Frenzy
games.description: Tickle Frenzy is a 10-second reaction challenge. Watch the moving feet and tap the matching colored feather button as fast as you can to rack up tickles!
games.controls: Tap the red, yellow or blue feather button that matches the feet's lane as fast as possible for 10 seconds.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Tidemark
games.description: Classic turn-based strategy in the spirit of Advance Wars: build, capture and push the front with 33 land, sea and air units, 29 commanders each with a battle-turning power, and a 27-mission campaign. Every attack shows its odds first — damage forecast, counterattacks and unit matchups — while tech trees, ratings and score records reward careful play. Open-source (MIT) game by CocoSgt, integrated under the MIT license. Supports 10 languages, mouse, touch, keyboard and gamepad.
games.controls: Click or tap to select units, move and attack — damage odds are previewed before you commit. Keyboard shortcuts available in-game; touch and gamepad supported. Build units in your factories/ports/airports, capture cities and buildings for income, and destroy or capture the enemy HQ to win.
games.author: CocoSgt

games.title: Tightrope Walker
games.description: Tightrope Walker is a nail-biting high-wire timing game. Swing from rope to rope across the sky and chase the longest distance record!
games.controls: Tap to cut the rope and launch. Tap again at the right moment to catch the next rope.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Tile Tap Rush
games.description: Tap your way through falling tiles in Tile Tap Rush. Only the lowest tile in each column counts - one wrong tap ends the run. How many tiles can you clear in 20 seconds?
games.controls: Tap or click only the lowest tile in the bottom row as it appears. Tapping any other tile ends the run. Score as many correct taps as you can in 20 seconds.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Time Travel Quiz
games.description: Travel back in time and discover who you would be in ancient China! Enter your name and choose your gender to find out which historical figure or ancient personality you would become. Will you be a mighty emperor, a legendary general, a beautiful consort, or a wise scholar? Take this fun personality quiz to unlock your ancient identity!
games.controls: Enter your name in the input field, select your gender (Male/Female), and click the 'Time Travel' button. The game will calculate your result based on your name and reveal your ancient historical persona. Click 'Try Again' to test with different names.
games.author: LightGame Team

games.title: Tower Defense
games.description: Classic tower defense game where you build defensive towers to prevent enemy invasion. Plan your resources wisely and survive 10 waves of enemies!
games.controls: Click to select tower type, then click on the map to place it. Basic Tower ($50): Normal attack; Cannon Tower ($100): High damage; Ice Tower ($150): Slows enemies.
games.author: LightGame Team
features: Three different types of defense towers: Basic Tower, Cannon Tower, and Ice Tower
Multiple enemy types including Normal, Fast, and Tank enemies
10 waves of enemies with increasing difficulty
Resource management system to allocate money for building towers

games.title: Twin Tempo Arena 双生擂台
games.description: A midnight paper-cut arena duel for two players on one keyboard. Three rotating rounds decide the match: a sword duel to break stamina, a lamp-capture race in the centre of the deck, and a sumo-style shove round where momentum sends rivals off a shrinking floating platform. Real acceleration, friction, jumping, blocking, dash invulnerability and momentum-based shove impulses. Play local two-player (vermilion P1 vs indigo P2) or practise against a three-tier lamp-shade AI. Round wins decide the score, draws trigger a push overtime, and a fastest-champion record is kept. Fully procedural Canvas art and synthesized WebAudio — no external assets.
games.controls: Local two-player: P1 uses A/D to move, W to jump, F to attack, hold G to block and press G while moving to dash. P2 uses Left/Right arrows, Up to jump, J or Numpad0 to attack, hold L or Numpad1 to block and press it while moving to dash. On touch screens each player gets their own on-screen pad. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts. Win two of the three rotating rounds (duel / lamp capture / shove) to take the match; a tied series goes to one push overtime round.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Twins Match Up
games.description: Test your memory in this engaging card matching puzzle game! Flip cards to find matching pairs and clear the board. Challenge yourself with different levels of difficulty and improve your memory skills.
games.controls: Click on cards to flip them. Find two identical cards to make a match. Clear all cards by matching all pairs to win!

games.title: Whisper Heist 声息窃影
games.description: A hand-drawn top-down stealth heist set in a lamplit indigo night. Slip past fixed watchmen, turning patrols and sharp-eared sentries across 12 crafted heists in three chapters. Read vision cones and wall occlusion, crouch through low crates, throw sound decoys to pull guards away, steal every lacquer relic and reach the exit before the 180-second lamp burns out. Noise ripples through the courtyard, guards investigate, and a three-stage alarm (suspicion, search, pursuit) can seal the night. Synthesized WebAudio ambience, no downloads.
games.controls: WASD / arrow keys move, Shift crouches (slow, near-silent, slips through low cover). Space or 1 throws a sound decoy toward the mouse or facing direction, E steals a relic or escapes through the exit once all relics are taken, P pauses, R restarts, M mutes. On touch: drag the left virtual stick to move and use the crouch / decoy / interact buttons; mute and pause are top-right.
games.author: LightGame

games.title: Wildflower Picker
games.description: Stroll through the meadow and pick as many wildflowers as you can in Wildflower Picker. Earn fun titles as your bouquet grows - how many flowers can you gather in one run?
games.controls: Tap or click flowers to pick them. Keep picking within the time limit to earn the best title.
games.author: LightGame
